Official v2026.6.5 / v0.16.0 Docker image misses the packaging module, disabling Hindsight version comparison.
Yuanbao adapter on v0.16.0 adds a fixed ~5s delay during clean gateway shutdown.
Hermes Desktop v0.16.0 profile switch can reuse the wrong terminal working directory.
v0.16.0 /model picker hard-caps provider results at 50, hiding large model catalogs.
Blank EMAIL_* env vars can enable email gateway retries against an empty host until a small VPS OOMs.
Dashboard/TUI/Desktop child processes can resolve the wrong HERMES_HOME, hiding profile-local skills.
Hermes Desktop v0.16.0 remote gateway image drag/drop sends a local path instead of uploading bytes, so the remote backend cannot read the image.
After upgrading to v0.16.0, the first config write can rewrite config.yaml to expanded defaults and drop custom_providers.
v0.16.0 prompt-size over-counts tools because it ignores enabled/disabled toolsets for the selected platform.
Hermes Desktop connected to a v0.16.0 backend treats multi-line /goal input as an empty slash command.
Hermes 0.16.0 remote gateway WebSocket admission still rejects packaged Electron desktop clients, leaving remote Desktop unable to connect.
v0.16.0 hermes cron list crashes with TypeError when any job has deliver: null, hiding all scheduled jobs.
v0.16.0 source installs can keep showing a stale commits-behind banner after a manual git pull.
v0.16.0 cron jobs can silently fall back after a main-model 404 and record the run as ok without surfacing the substitution in errors or audit logs.
Hermes Desktop 0.16.0 on Windows duplicates file preview links every time the session is reopened.
v0.16.0 Discord gateway on Windows times out after 30 seconds and the bot never comes online.
hermes 0.16.0 no_agent cron sessions are not closed, accumulating zombie rows in state.db.
0.16.0 installer can finish with ModuleNotFoundError for _ctypes during process-title setup on Ubuntu/Python 3.11.
Hermes Agent 0.16.0 Docker/container restarts can persist gateway_state=stopped after signal shutdown, so the gateway refuses to auto-start after upgrade/restart.
Hermes 0.16.0 Docker reverse-proxy/OIDC login can ignore HERMES_DASHBOARD_PUBLIC_URL, breaking callback URL construction unless dashboard.public_url is set in config.yaml.
Hermes Desktop 0.16.0 Cron view does not render script/no_agent jobs, leaving prompts blank and hiding run history for completed script jobs.
Hermes 0.16.0 Discord voice-only messages can crash the handler because transcription enrichment returns a bare prefix instead of the expected tuple.
Hermes Desktop 0.16.0 chat scrollbar can stop following new messages during streaming, forcing manual scrolling to see latest output.
Hermes Desktop 0.16.0 statusbar items do not pass title attributes, so expected hover tooltips are missing.
Hermes Desktop 0.16.0 on Windows clears unsent prompt text when navigating to Settings before submit.
Hermes Desktop 0.16.0 with a WSL backend only offers Windows paths in the working-directory picker, producing unreadable backend folders.
Hermes Desktop 0.16.0 repeatedly throws Path outside media roots 403 errors in hermes:api during image/media operations.
Hermes 0.16.0 user-installed hermes-gateway service can fail to start after reboot because systemd --user has no session bus.
Hermes 0.16.0 profile config provider blocks can replace defaults entirely, dropping inherited providers and custom_providers for worker profiles.
Hermes Desktop/TUI v0.16.0 silently ignores config.yaml shell hooks, so pre_tool_call policy hooks do not run for desktop sessions.
Hermes 0.16.0 can leak MiniMax-M3 Chinese reasoning tags into streaming and final user-visible responses.
Hermes send on v0.16.0 can drop remaining Discord chunks after a 429 because the standalone Discord path has no retry.
Clean npm installs for the v0.16.0 checkout can fail under npm 11 because package-lock.json is out of sync with @types/node.
Long v0.16.0 CLI sessions using a custom provider can hit APITimeoutError after client rebuild/retry, interrupting active agent work.
Hermes Desktop v0.16.0 on macOS can loop installation because the launcher probes system python3 and fails hermes_cli import before gateway startup.
Hermes Desktop v0.16.0 on WSL2 reports backend ready while Electron API requests time out, leaving Desktop unusable.
Hermes Desktop 0.16.0 renderer can crash with tapClientLookup index errors during session switches or streaming cancellation.
v0.16.0 update path emits npm ci lockfile mismatch noise before falling back to npm install.
